This historical convergence established the standard for modern quantitative research.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From a decision-theoretic perspective, the developer acts as an agent optimizing for both computational speed and code readability. The library anticipates this dual objective by providing explicit control over memory strides while offering intuitive syntactic sugar for slicing. Opposing agents, such as garbage collectors or OS memory managers, constantly vie for resources, necessitating the strict, predictable memory footprints enforced by these primitives.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To prevent catastrophic leakage between layers, strict anti-collinearity must be maintained between the underlying C-buffers and the Python object wrappers. Any attempt to mutate the shape of an array currently being iterated over must trigger an immediate veto, preventing race conditions. Furthermore, type-promotion rules must be rigorously enforced to stop implicit casting from corrupting high-precision financial or physical constants during intermediate calculations.
